name: Hat ENV-III
summary: Measures temperature, relative humidity and atmospheric pressure.

interface.alternate_qmp_address: 0x56 is supported by the driver; the current official U053-D manual and vendor bench report specify 0x70. Do not silently substitute another ENV revision.

host_bindings.notes: Vendor bench report gives SDA8/SCL0 at 100 kHz; see vendor_bench_report.candidate_connection. This has not been physically verified by the plugin and must not be applied to an unknown revision. Confirm seating/orientation and 3.3V. Do not copy legacy StickC SDA0/SCL26 or Grove GPIO9/10. GPIO0 is a boot-strapping signal: check cold boot with the HAT attached and do not force it low during reset.

support.meaning: Primary-source review plus separately labeled vendor bench notes. No accessory driver or emulator input is implemented; vendor results are not plugin physical acceptance.

first_hardware_check: Compare the attached HAT against the vendor SDA8/SCL0 candidate and manufacturer connector drawings; use 3.3V and start at 100 kHz.
Check both 0x44 and 0x70 on the selected bus. If only one responds, power down, reseat, then repeat; one responding chip is not a complete pass.
Show temperature in C, humidity in %RH and pressure in Pa or hPa with validity per quantity. Check that readings recover after a cold restart and remain available during use.
troubleshooting: Do not substitute ENV-II/BMP280 or ENV-IV/SHT40/BMP280 code.
The QMP driver default argument is 0x56 but the vendor ENV-III HAT example explicitly chooses QMP6988_SLAVE_ADDRESS_L=0x70.
Different addresses do not make two physical HATs stackable; check space, wiring and pull-ups.
Handle pressure and humidity/temperature failure independently; show unavailable instead of zero. This part does not measure CO2 or particulates.

app_fixture_plan.note: Use app-owned fixtures with units/validity; do not present generated values as real sensor data.

libraries.name: M5Unit-ENV
libraries.author: M5Stack
libraries.purpose: SHT3X/QMP6988 drivers and ENV-III HAT example; adapt bus pins explicitly.

vendor_bench_report.scope: Reported observations from a separate vendor build; not plugin driver or physical acceptance.
notes: The vendor used StickS3 top HAT SDA GPIO8 and SCL GPIO0 at 100 kHz, separate from Grove GPIO9/10.
Confirm exact HAT seating, connector orientation and supply before using this route; the plugin has not repeated the physical test.
The pressure chip at 0x70 intermittently disappeared while SHT30 at 0x44 still answered; reseating temporarily restored it.
Nearby board heat biased the temperature upward; missing pressure is a separate failure from temperature bias.
